capabilities.description: Check content against every boundary that matches where it goes, and record the crossing in the personal board. Fails naming each failing control, part and line.

inputSchema.description: Check the parts against every boundary that matches the action, destination and checkout.

action.description: The capability that sends the parts, such as github.pr-create.

from.description: The checkout's path in the personal board, such as /repos/board; left out for a checkout no board mounts.

parts.description: Each part of the content, by its name, such as pr.body.

to.description: Where the parts go, such as github:octo/board.

inputSchema.title: CheckInput

capabilities.name: check

Finding.description: What a control found wrong in a part: the text at fault, and its line when it has one.

line.description: The line of the part the text starts on.

pattern.description: The expression that matched, when its control shows it.

rewrite.description: How to rewrite the text, from a judged rule.

text.description: The text at fault: a match, a budget's count, or a quoted sentence.

Finding.title: Finding

Verdict.description: One control's verdict on one part, as `controls.evaluate` gave it.

findings.description: What the control found wrong, at most 20.

omitted.description: How many findings were left out past the first 20.

rule.description: The kind of the control's rule, or null for a written requirement.

status.description: passed, failed, skipped after a free rule failed, or stated.

Verdict.title: Verdict

outputSchema.description: The crossing written, the boundaries that matched, and every verdict; each check passed.

boundaries.description: The boundaries that matched, by their paths.

crossing.description: The crossing's path in the personal board.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the crossing's content, in 64 lowercase hex digits.

note.description: Why nothing was checked, or null.

unchecked.description: The parts no check of a matching boundary names, by name.

verdicts.description: Each check's verdict on each part it applies to.

outputSchema.title: CheckOutput

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the crossing's content, in 64 lowercase hex digits.

parts.description: Each part of the content, by its name, such as pr.body.

to.description: Where the parts go, such as github:octo/board.

inputSchema.title: VerifyInput

capabilities.name: verify

outputSchema.description: Whether a passing crossing exists for the digest.

crossing.description: The crossing's path, or null when there is none.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the crossing's content, in 64 lowercase hex digits.

passed.description: Whether the crossing exists, every check passed, and the same boundaries match it now.

result.description: What the destination returned, or null.

outputSchema.title: VerifyOutput

inputSchema.description: Add what the destination returned to the passing crossing of `digest`.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the crossing's content, in 64 lowercase hex digits.

result.description: What the destination returned, such as the pull request's URL.

description: The boundary plugin checks content, such as a pull request body, before it leaves a checkout, against the controls that boundaries in the personal board name for its destination. Use it before you send anything a boundary may cover. Run `board --personal call boundary.check` with the action, destination, checkout and parts on stdin; on `boundary::check::failed`, change what it names and check again. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: boundary
